description: Bifolio from an account ledger of a merchant. Refers to the sum contained in two purses (ṣurratayn) in the weight (sanja) of Alexandria: 151 dinars and 1 qīrāṭ. Repeatedly refers to "mawlāy al-shaky adāma allāh ʿizzahū"; it seems that this account is being drawn up to be submitted to this person. Refers to "the blessed bales" (al-aʿdāl al-mubāraka). States that Abū Yūsuf al-Ṣayrafī is due 30 dinars less 1/8. Mentions the price of saffron. Mentions that Yosef b. Yeshuʿa collected the sum due to him that mawlāy al-shaykh "had told me in his memorandum (tadhkira)." The writer states he is sending funds to repay "mawlāy al-shaykh" for the 80 dinars and the [...] wariq dirhams for a value of 5 dinars that the latter paid/loaned him "on the day of my departure." AA/ASE. Join: Alan Elbaum.
description_he: דף כפול מפנקס חשבונות של סוחר. מזכיר את אלכסנדריה, אבו יוסף אל-צירפי, יוסף בן ישועה. סכומים בעשרות ומאות דינרים.
